> ScreenHarmony Flex 2.10.2 Test Release 🙂

---

### What's Changed in this Test Build

- **Browser-Based Releases Only**: Removed in-app APK downloading, background package streaming, and `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` permission. All updates are now securely and transparently opened in your web browser on GitHub. 🫡
- **Diagnostic Log Scoping**: Hardened FileProvider paths strictly to application diagnostic logs. 😎
- **Verification Target**: Test build for Google Play Protect heuristic verification. 🧪
